subject.title: [Feature]: Allow topic/forum cron deliveries to use main-session announce/agent-turn flow instead of forced direct delivery

question: Should isolated cron text completions for resolved thread/topic targets gain a public opt-in route through main-session announce or agent-turn, and which failure fallback should that route use?
rationale: The requested fix adds new cron routing/config semantics in a compatibility-sensitive delivery path, and current policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces and fallback behavior.

options.title: Add per-job opt-in
options.body: Introduce a narrow per-job delivery route option for text-only thread/topic completions, keep direct delivery as default, and require focused upgrade/docs/tests for fallback semantics.

options.title: Keep direct-only
options.body: Preserve the current direct-delivery invariant for topic/forum cron jobs and document that main-agent rewrite is not supported for this surface.

options.title: Defer to broader async routing
options.body: Keep this issue linked to broader async/topic routing product work and avoid a cron-specific option until that contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Add per-job opt-in
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow per-job delivery route option for text-only thread/topic completions, keep direct delivery as default, and require focused upgrade/docs/tests for fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged cron announce-delivery work most directly owns the current dispatch behavior and documented scope boundary.
